svg.title: A public request form — SoftTrack web design mockup (#289)
svg.desc: Asking a team for something takes an account and a place on that team, and a customer reporting a problem has neither. A team can turn on a form at an address of its own, with fields its admin picks; a submission becomes a ticket in the intake status; and the requester gets a link that shows that ticket’s status and public comments and lets them reply.

g.text: the form at its own address, as anybody sees it
We answer within one working day. You will get an email with a link to follow
your request and reply to us.
Cannot add a second user to our account
When I invite a colleague the page says the email is already in use, but
she has never had an account.
Settings → Request form, off by default
Off: anybody with the address can ask.

Thanks Sam. Her address was used for a trial
in 2024. I have released it; please invite her

svg.text: Done when a team admin can turn on a form at its own address and choose whether it needs a sign-in and which fields it has, a submission becomes a ticket in the intake status
labelled as from the form, the requester gets a confirmation with a tokenised link whose hash is stored, the form is rate limited per address and per email typed with a honeypot
field and an attachment cap, the page says what happens next, and it sends noindex unless the admin chooses otherwise.

g.text: What happens next, in words the admin
A title and a description, always. The rest are
It faces the internet: rate limited per address
and per email typed, with a field only a script
would fill in, and attachments capped below
A form can create an idea, #280, and not a ticket.
The link carries a token, and only its hash is stored. Public
